daily_wisdom: The market rewards decisive action and punishes hesitation equally. Your job is not to be right about every trade - your job is to size your winners correctly when momentum is on your side and cut your losers ruthlessly when it is not. A trader who is right 55% of the time with a 3:1 reward-to-risk ratio will compound wealth rapidly. A trader who is right 70% of the time but lets losers run will be destroyed. The stop loss is not an admission of defeat - it is the most important tool in your arsenal. Set it before you enter. Honor it when it triggers.
